content:
amanda: kicking off bring-up for asia-sg1 GPU cluster — pushing gitops/helm pipeline today. Need consensus on artifact streaming policy and image replication TTL. We saw ~7m lag last time. Can infra folks confirm plan?

raj: On it. Proposed flow: 1) push images to central registry (gcr/redwood-prod), 2) registry-replica job streams to region (pullthrough + signed manifests), 3) Helm release via ArgoCD pointing to regional image tag mirror. If we enable async streaming, we need fallback to cross-region pull for the first N hours (rate-limited).

sylvie: Helm values notes: set `image.pullPolicy: IfNotPresent`, and `image.repository` to the mirror host. Add `imagePullSecrets` and tolerate 302 redirects from mirror. Also propose replica sync window <=10m for inference models (larger models may be streamed ahead of time).

infra-bot: registry-replica job scheduled: pipeline/id: replicate-asia-sg1-1987, state: queued. Next run in ~5m.

mike: Question: egress costs if we fallback to cross-region pull? We should cap cross-region fallback to 1% of traffic and add rate-limit. Also ensure VPC egress NAT quotas are sufficient: current NAT quotas for asia-sg1 = 5000 conn, estimate peak 1200, looks ok but confirm before ramp.

sylvie: Also double-check image signature verification — signed manifests enforced by regional registry (cosign). Add cosign public key to ArgoCD repo creds so autopilot helm pulls validate signatures.

raj: Operational plan checklist I'm going to follow: - enable registry replication with incremental sync - configure ArgoCD AppSet with mirror host - deploy staging helm release with canary traffic - run smoke tests (pull and model load) - monitor artifact lag metric `registry.replica.lag_seconds` and `replica.errors`

amanda: Smoke test snippet please (curl or k8s)?

raj: Use this quick pod probe: `kubectl run deploy-check --image=mirror-host/probe:latest --restart=Never --command -- sh -c 'curl -sS http://model-service:8080/health || exit 1'`

julia: I'll own the handoff doc + postmortem template. After successful canary, I'll create a ticket in #eng-oncall with capacity ops runbook and cost projection. Also adding fallback TTL and automatic purge policy (retain 7 days for model artifacts, longer for pinned releases).

mike: Please tag images with build meta: `commit=<sha>` + `region=<mirror>` hash. Helps tracing. :thumbsup:

amanda: sgtm. I'll wait for registry-replica job to finish and then do canary deploy at 15:30 PT. Ping me when replicate job completes.

infra-bot: pipeline/replicate-asia-sg1-1987: SUCCESS in 210s. synced 42 images. registry.replica.lag_seconds = 12

raj: Replica looks healthy. Initiating ArgoCD sync for canary (appset: inference-models-asia-sg1-canary).

sylvie: Canary passed basic smoke (model load + 1k token gen sample). No errors. Moving to ramp (10% -> 50% over 30m).

amanda: closing this thread — will post final handoff after ramp. :white_check_mark:
